verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a programmatic application flow (Person/Business/Account Application) and third-party KYC/KYB vendor integration, plus an Incremental KYC mode that runs KYC outside account opening — supporting the core 'programmatic verification' story. However, evidence does not show explicit document collection endpoints, watchlist screening details, or a full state-machine model of application statuses. missing for 10: explicit document upload/collection API details, watchlist/OFAC screening specifics, documented application state enumeration and transitions.
